sampleContent: (Courtesy REcolorado) The 11,000-square-foot mansion at Captain’s Rock Ranch was constructed in 1995 of chinked logs and Gallegos stone. (Courtesy REcolorado) By Sara B. HansenPUBLISHED: August 8, 2025 at 3:00 PM MDTA mansion on 667 acres in Evergreen sold for $10 million last month, topping local home sales. Captain’s Rock Ranch, as the property at 3999 Evans Ranch Road is known, includes an 11,376-square-foot mansion with five bedrooms and eight bathrooms. The home was constructed in 1995 of chinked logs and Gallegos stone. The property includes an indoor riding arena with eight stalls, a tack room, and an office, as well as a refurbished 1900s schoolhouse that the owners saved and moved to the property. That building could be used as a guest retreat or a studio. The property, sold by Brent Redstone and Anne M.
